# BillPay (fictitious third-party migration)

A hand-written migration of the fictitious `dbo.sp_pago_orden` (Banco Ficticio) by an invented vendor, Contoso: a
Spring Boot service with its own API, tables and an HTTP call to the core banking debit. Written for the tests of the
NexTI platform's independent validation (Flow 4, ADR-0025); nothing here comes from a real customer or vendor.
